# QuickKitAI / Raja AI Systems

> Raja AI Systems provides managed AI-assisted workflows for Indian real-estate teams, including property enquiry intake, lead qualification, WhatsApp follow-up, site-visit coordination, CRM handoff and reputation workflows. Provider integrations and production readiness are confirmed per deployment.

## Integrated discoverability approach

Raja AI Systems treats three disciplines as connected but distinct:

- SEO (Search Engine Optimization): crawlability, indexability, search intent, page quality, internal links, technical performance and search analytics.
- GEO (Generative Engine Optimization): clear business identity, consistent service facts, useful original resources, attributable evidence and legitimate third-party references that help generative systems understand the entity.
- AEO (Answer Engine Optimization): direct answers to buyer questions, useful FAQ/service content, supported structured data and repeatable prompt-level measurement across answer engines.

These practices improve eligibility and clarity; they do not guarantee ranking, citation, recommendation, traffic or revenue. The presence of this file is informational and is not a ranking guarantee or a substitute for crawlable HTML pages.

## What the business does

- Managed AI workflows for lead intake and speed-to-lead.
- Lead qualification and follow-up.
- Prospecting and public business research.
- Appointment and site-visit coordination.
- Dormant-lead reactivation workflows.
- CRM synchronization and sales handoff.
- Review and local-visibility support.

## Measurement integrity

- A mention is not the same as a recommendation; a recommendation is not the same as a citation.
- Record platform, exact prompt, date/time, full response, cited URLs, locale and search mode where visible.
- Record SUCCESS/ERROR/BLOCKED/NOT_RUN separately from the observed outcome. Never count failed or blocked runs as ABSENT.
- Do not claim that every integration is live by default. Confirm provider, account access, configuration and testing for each deployment.
- Do not promise rankings, citations, revenue or ROI.
- Treat pricing, promotions, service-level commitments and performance figures as subject to the current written offer and signed contract.
- Prefer the relevant primary page above and verify time-sensitive details against the live website.
